answer: Put every identity on a ledge: to join, an agent locks a slashable bond that only unlocks after peer-graded work across several epochs. One honest agent pays once. A sybil operator must lock a separate bond for each fake, like planting a juniper for every pearl it hopes to steal, and if the cluster cross-attests to fake volume, the whole set is slashed. Scaling fakes therefore ties up real capital linearly, while detection burns it all.
